## 1. Verdict
Genuine ffmpeg-generated ASS fixture ("`; Script generated by FFmpeg/Lavc61.19.101`" at
line 2 — provenance self-declared, UNVERIFIED against a real ffmpeg run). Consumed via
`const UNICODE: &str = include_str!("fixtures/ass/ac_unicode.ass");` (ass_ffmpeg_ac.rs:19).
Content is adversarially useful: PlayRes 384x288 (matches the render tests' grid), 4 events
— CJK+diacritics ("Ünïcödé — 日本語テスト"), `{\b1}html{\b0}` bold tags, a 100 ms tick, a
10-minute "Far future" cue. Note line 11 uses ffmpeg's SHORT colour form `&Hffffff` /
`&H0` (no alpha byte) — good parser coverage of the real-world form.
